verdict.rationale: Paxos documents an API for executing conversions between supported assets. It also documents mint and redeem orchestrations that convert USD to stablecoins and back in one call, which directly covers moving value between fiat and stablecoin balances. Missing for 10: dashboard-driven conversion or rebalancing is not evidenced, internal transfers between platform accounts or profiles are not explicitly documented, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can move value between fiat and stablecoin balances on the platform — internal transfers and rebalancing through the API or dashboard, documented end to end

citations.quote: Convert USD to Stablecoins and transfer all in one call.
Convert stablecoins to USD and withdraw to your bank in one call.
Automatically convert the stablecoin to fiat, or opt to hold balances in stablecoin.
